boosted.description: User-specified +50% energy; not asserted to be an official universal value.

interpretation.conditional: Given all planned essence direct-weather attempts failed and capturing is still required; both weekly lucky counts and pity counters start at zero.
interpretation.zeroMass: The two essence counts are independent plan inputs; no use order is defined. If planned energy is below 10500, k=u+v, mass at N=0 is 1-0.97^k and the remaining-energy conditional PMF is multiplied by 0.97^k. If planned energy guarantees weather, all mass is at N=0; actual use counts and the direct-weather share are unspecified.
interpretation.minimum: minN=1 is the theoretical positive support minimum. minimumProbability.directWeather is the universal first-capture direct-weather component; total also includes first-capture energy completion.
interpretation.maximum: observedMax is the largest simulated stopping count, not a proof of the theoretical maximum or of 100% coverage.
interpretation.moments: Population moments of the empirical PMF; quantiles use the smallest integer whose empirical CDF reaches the requested probability.
interpretation.shape: Use the discrete empirical PMF/CDF directly; no normal distribution is fitted.
interpretation.index: thresholds[j] has remainingEnergy=10500-240*j, j=0..43; all energy comparisons use exact >= thresholds.
